contract: A client that exhausts its produce bucket cannot spend another client's tokens.
A request past the maximum throttle is refused without being accepted. A delay within the maximum is accepted and still owns its byte permit.
Disconnect releases only connection permits. Lowering rates does not drop work that was already accepted.
limits: This is an in-memory window, not a Kafka throttle response and not durable quota administration.
Request percentage quotas and per-user credential quotas are not implemented.
Not a production qualification and not a fastest-server claim.
